name: Elevator pitch writer
why: Turns 'what we do, for whom and the result' into short spoken pitches, the starting point for a firm's positioning line.

name: Landing page fix loop
why: Rewrites a service or 'work with me' page against your facts and rechecks it, before the claims check and sign-off.

name: Clear-before-clever copy checker
why: Finds unclear lines in page and email copy, so a stressed first-time client understands it on one read.

name: FAQ page writer from customer questions
why: Turns the questions enquirers really ask into an FAQ page with answers first, for service pages.

name: Blog post publish check loop
why: Matches every claim in an explainer or newsletter to its proof before it goes to the firm's reviewer.

name: Testimonial request writer
why: Writes a short testimonial request with three easy questions and a follow-up, to pair with permission wording.

name: Public review reply desk
why: Drafts checked replies to new reviews and holds risky ones, which suits firms that must protect client confidentiality.

name: Sales call prep assistant
why: Prepares a one-page plan for a consultation or discovery call and a follow-up draft afterwards.

name: Turn a sales call into a checked proposal
why: Turns consultation notes into a checked fee proposal, which the firm sends itself because proposals can bind it.

name: Follow-up email sequence writer
why: Builds polite follow-ups with a new reason each and a stop rule, for people who enquired but did not book.

name: Weekly newsletter keeper
why: Turns the firm's notes into a plain-words client newsletter, ready for the general-information label and sign-off.

name: Lead grader
why: Sorts enquiries by how soon each needs to act, so the firm replies to urgent ones first.
